usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all datastores configured on a specific PBS remote registered in PDM, including their retention schedules, maintenance state, and GC/prune settings. The caller must hold Resource.Audit on the remote path — a read-only API token with that privilege is sufficient. Datastores in maintenance-mode (especially 'offline') will appear in the list but may be inaccessible for backup or restore operations.
tips: Check the 'maintenance-mode' field in each returned datastore before triggering sync or verify jobs — an 'offline' or 'read-only' mode will cause those jobs to fail.
Retention policy fields (keep-daily, keep-weekly, etc.) are per-datastore config snapshots from the remote; they reflect the remote PBS node's settings, not a PDM-level override.
The 'path' field is the absolute filesystem path on the remote PBS server, useful for cross-referencing with disk usage or SMART data from that host.
Remote names must match the pattern /^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._\-]*)$/ with length 2–32; mismatches will return a 400 before reaching the remote.
